routes.question: Which part of a structural analogy survives missing catalytic elements?

steps.available: Published LytM-fold similarity suggests metallopeptidase chemistry.
steps.actual_probe: Inspect primary structure result and current4BH5/2B13 molecule/contact records, then author-to-entity residue mappings.
steps.result: 4BH5 has no listed Zn;2B13 has Zn contacts H210/D214/H293. The corresponding paper-assigned EnvC residues W320/V324/Y401 are observed in4BH5.
steps.changed_question: Retain fold support; ask whether the retained cleft serves a different biological role. Absence of a required catalytic center is not absence of function.
steps.limit: Correspondence comes from authors; no new structural superposition.4BH5 also contains potassium, so a claim of no metals would be false.

routes.question: Does the phenotype fail because protein is absent/mislocalized, or because activation is impaired?

steps.available: Domain substitutions can disrupt many properties at once.
steps.actual_probe: Parse original Table1 and select variants with preserved stability and septal localization but defective full-length function.
steps.changed_question: These retained properties weaken abundance/location explanations. Ask whether isolated variants also fail in paired AmiB activation.

steps.actual_probe: Read complete purified-pair assay Results and Methods.
steps.changed_question: Impaired activation persists outside the localization setting. Keep the activator assignment; inspect whether the molecular binding mechanism itself was tested.
steps.boundary: Direct complex detection failed in this paper; modeled regulatory-helix contacts are not measured binding.

routes.question: At which part of a repeated reaction does a component contribute?

steps.available: The complete system produces modified tRNA; TsaE hydrolyzes ATP.
steps.actual_probe: Read component-omission time courses and product-release assay, including assay concentrations.
steps.changed_question: Initial transfer and product release remain possible without TsaE; ask what fails when another cycle is needed.

steps.actual_probe: Read ATPase-defective and switch-uncoupling variants with assembly controls.
steps.changed_question: Hydrolysis is required for repeated operation in this system but hydrolysis alone is insufficient. A post-reaction reset is supported; detailed conformational mechanism remains partly modeled.

routes.question: Do apparently conflicting papers measure the same requirement?

steps.available: 2015E.coli paper calls ATPase dispensable;2018/2019Thermotoga papers require it for multiple turnover.
steps.actual_probe: Read original2015 supplementary assay rather than infer conditions from its abstract; compare with2018 Methods/Discussion.

actual_extracted_conditions.E_coli2015: 25ug purified overexpressed cellular tRNA in80uL;2.5uM each protein;90min endpoint.
actual_extracted_conditions.Thermotoga2018: In-vitro-transcribed tRNA; time-course incorporation and product-release measurements, explicitly distinguishing product per enzyme complex.

steps.changed_question: Species, substrate preparation and measurement differ. Ask whether absolute turnover is comparable before choosing a universal mechanistic explanation.
steps.boundary: The2018 authors leave species differences versus low-turnover assay explanations open. These readings do not resolve that question; no new kinetic data.

research_only: No repository changes, scientific runtime execution, target-state writes, experiments or scoring changes.
